category: debrid / cloud download service (premium links, torrent, usenet)

free_tier.stated: 'Try a Magnet, Torrent or NZB free. One free job per 24 hours, up to 500 MB. No account required.' Paid service 'Start from $2.99 and pay only for the GBs you use. No monthly subscription.'
free_tier.notes: The free job is scoped to magnet, torrent or NZB. A file-host link is the paid product; the page does not offer a free file-host unlock.

per_object_cap.stated: 500 MB per free job ('up to 500 MB').
per_object_cap.notes: Paid per-GB jobs have no stated per-file cap on the landing page.

retention.stated: unverified: files are kept in the account's cloud and can be streamed or re-downloaded; no retention period is stated on the landing page.

egress.terms: Pay per GB of traffic on paid plans; the free job includes its 500 MB. No per-TB price is listed on the landing page, only the $2.99 entry point.
egress.price_per_tb: start from USD 2.99, pay per GB (rate not stated on the landing page)

interface_detail: Web app (Chrome/Firefox/mobile) plus a documented JDownloader integration page; file management, zip/unzip, split/join, streaming. No public API documentation was found on the pages read.
tooling: Browser; JDownloader integration is documented by the vendor at dasan.co/jdownloader.
chaining: It is the debrid layer itself: it accepts a host link, torrent, magnet or NZB and returns a direct link, so it replaces the whole downloader chain rather than slotting into it.

limits.value: 500 MB per job on the free path
1 job per 24 hours on the free path

limits_note: The free path is a trial for torrents and usenet, not for host links. The paid path is metered per GB with a $2.99 minimum, which is the debrid model other rows price.
binding_note: At 1 TiB/month the 500 MB per-job ceiling is the harder wall than the 1 job/day: 500 MB times 30 days is 15 GB a month, and a single 4 GB file cannot be fetched at all on the free path.

identity_cost.detail: 'No account required' for the one free job per 24 hours; an account is required to buy or hold a balance.

reliability_note: Cloudflare fronts the site and challenged a plain client probe (challenge detected on a 200 response), so unattended automation needs a browser session. Free jobs are capped so low that queue failures are cheap to retry.
confidence_note: The free-trial terms and the $2.99 entry price are quoted from the live landing page; the per-GB rate, retention and file-host free path are not published, so the paid economics stay unverified.

evidence.proved: 'One free job per 24 hours, up to 500 MB. No account required.'; 'Start from $2.99 and pay only for the GBs you use'; host list including Rapidgator, KatFile, Keep2Share, 1Fichier, Turbobit, Mega
